principle: Mining should be able to live on the device, not consume the device
observation_method: Use iPhone as passive logger; never background iPad Safari during HFB or six timed RDE runs; snapshots from visible iPad status bar and wall meter, not OS navigation.
power_boundary: Paired integrated AC Wh over exactly matching HFB run; compute mean W from delta Wh / hours, no idle subtraction; wall W alone does not prove net battery charging.
charging_caveat: Apple iPad 80-percent charging limit may naturally show 80 to 75 percent before charging restarts; avoid false failure.

interpretation.sustainable: Late SOC stable or increasing with continuing real DP6 throughput and no critical event; NOT 24h or 24/7 certification.
interpretation.marginal: SOC initially declines then plateaus or shows bounded charge-policy oscillation; do not force a FAIL.
interpretation.unsustainable: Repeated post-warmup SOC samples persistently decline with power connected and credible heavy-normal baseline; risk evidence, NOT mathematical proof of eventual shutdown.
interpretation.inconclusive: SOC display quantization, 80-percent charge-limit hysteresis, missing samples, 100-percent plateau masking, changes in power/ambient or uncertain adequacy.
interpretation.invalid: Normal heavy baseline also drains continuously, known faulty battery/cable/adapter or abnormal thermal/charger environment; do not blame DP6 alone.
interpretation.critical: Stop and preserve evidence at OS thermal alert, shutdown, abnormal excessive heat, disconnection or rapid severe drain; never demand a destructive endurance test.

thresholds: No new numeric frozen PASS/FAIL gate. A post-warmup fall of 3 percentage points over >=30m is a review flag only.
boundaries: RDE runs testnet SHA256 not DP6; never claim 153min DP6
No re-run previous MTS tip gate
No work/W from unmatched charging state
